## About the team

L2IB is a research team of the [CIRI — Centre International de Recherche en
Infectiologie](https://ciri.ens-lyon.fr/teams/lib) in Lyon, France
(Inserm U1111 · CNRS UMR5308 · ENS de Lyon · Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1),
co-led by **L. Genestier** and **E. Bachy**.

Our work sits at the interface of fundamental immunology, hematology and
computational biology. We combine primary patient samples, functional
immunology and machine learning on large clinical cohorts to understand
lymphomagenesis and to improve how patients are diagnosed and stratified.

The team is based at the Lyon Sud campus and works in close collaboration with
the clinical hematology departments of the Hospices Civils de Lyon.
